description: bits-ui's Toggle compiled from its published source through shadcn-svelte's unmodified toggle wrapper (tailwind-variants toggleVariants in its module script; mergeProps with an object literal { type }) and its demos toggle-sm, toggle-lg, toggle-outline, toggle-with-text and toggle-disabled, and a toggle bound to the app (bind:pressed, onPressedChange, disabled from outside). The main demo, toggle-demo, is rejected: it fills its icon with a Tailwind fill utility, CSS that Blitz does not apply to inline SVG (E_CSS_PROPERTY). Pressed by clicks, by Enter and Space on the focused toggle (the button's own activation), from outside; disabled toggles ignore clicks; aria-pressed, data-state on/off, the hover and pressed backgrounds and the keyboard focus ring (pixel regions)
